not_applicable_cost.delegate: Nobody is given access to the leaver's mailbox.
not_applicable_cost.vacation: No auto-reply: people who email the leaver get no notice.

steps.label: Reset password
steps.summary: Set leaver@e.com's password to a random one nobody is shown, so the old password stops working (the mailbox stays live)
command_lines: gam update user leaver@e.com password random changepassword off

steps.label: Revoke access & sign out
steps.summary: Sign leaver@e.com out of every web and device session, delete their app passwords, invalidate their 2-Step Verification backup codes and revoke every connected app's access (OAuth tokens). 2-Step Verification itself is left on
command_lines: gam user leaver@e.com deprovision signout

steps.label: Turn off forwarding
steps.summary: Turn off automatic forwarding of leaver@e.com's incoming mail (harmless if it's already off). Gmail filters that forward mail are not changed
command_lines: gam user leaver@e.com forward off

steps.label: Set delegate
steps.summary: Give mgr@e.com delegate access to leaver@e.com's mailbox
command_lines: gam user leaver@e.com add delegate mgr@e.com

steps.label: Set auto-responder
steps.summary: Auto-reply — “Subj”: Msg
command_lines: gam user leaver@e.com vacation on subject Subj message Msg html contactsonly false domainonly false start Started end NotSpecified

steps.label: Transfer Drive & Calendar ownership
steps.summary: Transfer leaver@e.com's Drive/Docs (private and shared files) and calendars to mgr@e.com
command_lines: gam create datatransfer leaver@e.com drive,calendar mgr@e.com all

steps.label: Remove from everyone's calendars
steps.summary: Remove leaver@e.com's access to every active user's primary calendar — one domain-wide call that visits every user, so it can take many minutes (stopped and reported failed after 60 min). Secondary calendars shared with leaver@e.com, and suspended users' calendars, are not swept
command_lines: gam all users delete calendaracls primary leaver@e.com

steps.label: 30-day reminder for mgr@e.com
steps.summary: Add a calendar reminder on mgr@e.com for 2026-07-23 to confirm deletion

command_lines: gam update user leaver@example.com password random changepassword off

steps.summary: Sign leaver@example.com out of every web and device session, delete their app passwords, invalidate their 2-Step Verification backup codes and revoke every connected app's access (OAuth tokens). 2-Step Verification itself is left on
command_lines: gam user leaver@example.com deprovision signout

steps.label: Turn off forwarding
steps.summary: Turn off automatic forwarding of leaver@example.com's incoming mail (harmless if it's already off). Gmail filters that forward mail are not changed
command_lines: gam user leaver@example.com forward off

steps.label: Set delegate
steps.summary: Give mgr@example.com delegate access to leaver@example.com's mailbox
command_lines: gam user leaver@example.com add delegate mgr@example.com

steps.label: Set auto-responder
steps.summary:
Auto-reply — “Lee Ver has left”: Line one.
Ask Mo Gr (mgr@example.com)
command_lines:
gam user leaver@example.com vacation on subject 'Lee Ver has left' message 'Line one.
Ask Mo Gr (mgr@example.com)' html contactsonly false domainonly false start Started end NotSpecified

steps.label: Transfer Drive & Calendar ownership
steps.summary: Transfer leaver@example.com's Drive/Docs (private and shared files) and calendars to mgr@example.com
command_lines: gam create datatransfer leaver@example.com drive,calendar mgr@example.com all

steps.label: Remove from everyone's calendars

Secondary calendars shared with a b@example.com, and suspended users' calendars, are not swept
command_lines: gam all users delete calendaracls primary 'a b@example.com'

steps.label: 14-day reminder for 😀@example.com
steps.summary: Add a calendar reminder on 😀@example.com (also invites a b, who gets an invitation email) for 2052-03-24 to confirm deletion
commands: Offboarding a b@example.com: confirm with IT whether to delete the account
a b@example.com was offboarded on 2052-03-10 (password reset; data + calendars transferred to 😀@example.com). When you're sure it's safe, tell IT to delete the account.
command_lines: gam user '😀@example.com' add event primary summary 'Offboarding a b@example.com: confirm with IT whether to delete the account' start allday 2052-03-24 end allday 2052-03-25 description "a b@example.com was offboarded on 2052-03-10 (password reset; data + calendars transferred to 😀@example.com). When you're sure it's safe, tell IT to delete the account." attendee 'a b' sendupdates all
